Storefront and entrance installation in Winnipeg

We supply and install storefront framing and aluminum entrances for apartment buildings, retail and offices. We set the frames, hang and adjust the doors, and leave the entrance working the way it should.

An entrance is the most used part of a building, so the details matter: a level sill, square frames, doors that close on their own and latch every time, and seals that keep the wind out in January.

A new aluminum entrance is the simplest way to upgrade an apartment building: it changes how the building looks from the street, stops drafts in the lobby and gives tenants a door that works. We also do new storefronts for retail and offices.

Common questions

Can you replace the old entrance of an apartment building?
Yes. We supply the new entrance, remove the old frame and doors, set the new one in the existing opening, and seal and finish the perimeter.
What do you need to quote a storefront or entrance?
Drawings if there are any. For a replacement, photos and rough sizes are enough to start, and we measure on site before ordering.
Do you work outside Winnipeg?
Yes. We are based in Winnipeg and take projects across Manitoba.
